name: Tampa Metal Works Inc
old_description: Our team specializes in custom fabrication, installation and delivery – a service that greatly benefits projects with tight deadlines. At Tampa Metal Works, we take pride in supporting local businesses. That’s what we work with trusted partners to ensure you receive the quality you deserve.
about:
Tampa Metal Works operates from Tampa, Florida, where it has served commercial clients across the state for nearly 40 years. The company is locally owned and operated, though no founding year or individual founders are disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication, in-house manufacturing, field welding, and on-site installation, along with prompt delivery of finished components. Its product line includes scuppers, downspouts, collector boxes, chimney caps, and handrails, all formed from brake metal and flat stock held in inventory to support quick turnaround.

Primary customers are roofing and sheet-metal contractors on commercial construction projects. Tampa Metal Works services Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Polk, Manatee, Hardee, Highlands, Sarasota, and DeSoto counties, and offers nationwide shipping for orders outside its core region.

The company emphasizes its understanding of contractor schedules, citing a broad in-stock flat-stock inventory and reliable delivery as key differentiators. It operates under a Florida roofing contractor license (CCC1329561), holds memberships in the Florida Roofing and Sheet Metal Contractors Association and the National Roofing Contractors Association, and follows SMACNA standards for fabrication and installation.

name: Tasly Pharmaceuticals, Inc
old_description: At Tasly Pharmaceuticals Inc. (TPI), we are dedicated to delivering effective, safe, and highquality botanical medicines that complement modern medical practices. Our innovative solutions provide a synergistic approach to healthcare, offering patients alternative and long-term treatment options while working alongside conventional medicine.
about:
Tasly Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Rockville, Maryland. The company was established to integrate botanical science with modern pharmaceutical innovation, developing safe and effective botanical medicines that complement conventional treatments.

The company’s core focus is the development and manufacture of botanical drugs, most notably T89 (Dantonic®), a herbal medicine-derived compound that has completed an FDA Phase III global clinical trial. Manufacturing takes place on what the company describes as the world’s largest proprietary automatic dripping pill and packaging production line, a fully automated system featuring digital control, high-speed operation, precision pill counting, real-time imprint monitoring, and automated defect removal. The production process follows Good Extracting Practice (GEP) covering extraction, condensation, chromatography, crystallization, filtration, and drying, while quality systems adhere to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Good Agricultural Practice (GAP), and Good Laboratory Practice (GLP). Tasly reports more than 500 worldwide regulatory approvals for its products.

Tasly serves the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries, targeting medical professionals, regulatory agencies, and patients seeking botanical alternatives. The company has presented Phase III clinical data for T89 at the American College of Cardiology (ACC) 2018, participated in the Trade Winds ASEAN Mission and Business Forum in 2023, and exhibited at BioJapan in 2022, indicating engagement with global pharmaceutical markets and research communities.

Tasly’s stated differentiation rests on bridging traditional healing wisdom with rigorous clinical validation, aiming to revolutionize patient care through scientifically validated botanical medicines. The company emphasizes its first-in-class FDA Phase III achievement for a botanical drug and its fully automated, digitally controlled production line as key factors that set it apart.

name: Tech Energy America LLC
old_description: Tech Energy America is a wholesale electrical distributor in Scottsdale, AZ — transformers, wire & cable, and UL-listed switchgear for contractors and industrial, since 2009.
about:
Tech Energy America LLC is a wholesale electrical distributor based in Scottsdale, Arizona, founded in 2009. The company was started to address contractors' and industrial buyers' difficulties in obtaining straightforward pricing and reliable delivery from large distributors.

The company operates a Scottsdale warehouse and an in-house switchgear assembly line, distributing products from manufacturers such as JST Power, CME Wire, Priority Wire, Southwire, and Square D/Schneider Electric. It also manufactures UL-listed switchgear, panelboards, and VFDs, and supplies PV wire, XHHW-2 wire, EV charging equipment, and related materials.

Its customers include licensed electrical contractors, solar EPCs (such as Solar Gain Inc.), industrial buyers, and resellers across Arizona and nationwide. The company serves the solar, EV charging, commercial, and residential construction sectors.

The company emphasizes bilingual (English/Spanish) service across all functions, same-day RFQ turnaround for most BOMs, and documentation by default with spec sheets and warranty paperwork. It was founded to provide straight pricing and reliable delivery, and it combines distribution with in-house manufacturing to offer a single source for projects.

name: TechNH, Inc.
old_description: Our proven 5-step transfer process protects supply continuity, confirms tool condition, and gets you back to stable production fast.
about:
TechNH, Inc. was founded in 1982 in a small corner of a Nashua, New Hampshire mill building. Now headquartered in Merrimack, NH, the company has grown from a modest operation into a global precision injection molder.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding, offering insert molding, over-molding, and in-house mold making and repair. Its facility houses presses ranging from 16 to 780 tons, capable of shot weights from 1/2 ounce to 128 ounces. Services extend to design for manufacturability, mold flow analysis, cleanroom molding, and secondary operations such as pad printing, assembly, and packaging. An in-house regulatory team supports compliance with ISO 13485:2016, ITAR, FDA 21 CFR 820, and UL standards, including IQ/OQ/PQ validation.

TechNH serves medical device, defense, alternative energy, water treatment, and industrial customers. Testimonials reference clients in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, and New Hampshire, including healthcare and industrial OEMs. The company assigns each project a dedicated team comprising an account manager, customer service representative, program manager, and a degreed plastics engineer.

TechNH emphasizes a 5-step tool transfer process designed to protect supply continuity and confirm tool condition without production downtime. Core values—adaptability, integrity, enthusiasm, pride in work, and reliability—guide operations. Nearly 40% of the workforce has more than five years' tenure, and about a quarter have exceeded a decade, reflecting a culture the company cites as a differentiator.

name: Technotronix
old_description: AS9100/ISO 9001 custom cable and wire harness assemblies (secondary to PCB assembly)
about:
Technotronix operates from Anaheim, California, and was founded in 1981. The privately held company specializes in printed circuit board fabrication and assembly, serving customers across the United States.

The company provides a full suite of PCB services including layout, fabrication (rigid, flexible, and metal-core), assembly using through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed technologies, as well as box build, cable harness assembly, metal fabrication, and material management. Its production floor runs Mydata pick-and-place machines, Mycronic 200, Heller reflow systems, wave soldering, and a BGA rework station, supporting prototype runs through high-volume in-line production. Inspection is performed with CRX-100 X-ray, benchtop AOI, and manual checks.

Technotronix serves OEMs, startups, and enterprises in automotive, electronics, telecommunications, medical, renewable energy, and defense sectors. The company highlights work on ECG recorders, bio-analytical instruments, dialysis equipment, hearing aids, LED lighting, and electric vehicle prototypes.

The company emphasizes no minimum order requirements, 24-hour prototype assembly turnaround, and a global vendor network for time-sensitive needs. It holds ISO 9001:2015, AS9100 Rev. D, and ANAB ISO/IEC 17021 accreditation, and offers lead-free and chemical-free material options.

name: Techstar Molding
old_description: At Techstar Molding, we strive to lead the custom plastic injection molding industry by delivering exceptional value and superior quality, while remaining fully dedicated to helping our customers succeed. With decades of experience and a hands-on, customer-first approach, we deliver results you can count on!
about:
Techstar Molding operates from Pasadena, Texas, in the greater Houston area. The company has provided custom plastic injection molding services for over 40 years, though a specific founding year is not published. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in public materials.

The shop runs a full-service injection molding operation covering design consultation, CAD and DFM analysis, mold flow simulation, rapid prototyping via 3D printing and CNC machining, custom mold design and fabrication, and production molding on presses ranging from 150 to 1,000 tons with shot capacities exceeding seven pounds. Value-added services include insert molding, post-molding assembly, finishing, custom packaging, inspection, and warehouse management with JIT and VMI options.

Techstar serves a broad industrial base that includes automotive, industrial equipment, agriculture, food service, construction, consumer goods, chemical packaging, HVAC, and oil and gas. Customers range from entrepreneurs launching first products to established corporations needing scale-up or tool transfer support.

The company emphasizes a collaborative, customer-first approach, positioning itself as a turnkey partner that manages every stage from concept to delivery. It highlights domestic manufacturing — "Proudly Made in America" — and a commitment to responsiveness and long-term client success.

name: Teets Cattle Company
old_description: At Teets Cattle Company, we believe simple is best. That’s why we take pride in raising our cattle and crops right here on our farm alongside our family. We work together as a family to provide food for our nation.
about:
Teets Cattle Company operates from Lost River, West Virginia, where Matt and Jill Teets run the family farm alongside their sons Justin, JW, and Jordan. The business centers on raising cattle and crops on their own land, following a straightforward approach the family describes as "simple is best." No founding year is publicly stated.

The farm produces beef sold directly as quality cuts, and the family also raises crops. Beyond daily operations, Teets Cattle Company hosts annual agricultural events that draw regional participants, including the Bulls N' Barrels Rodeo, the Teets/Griswold Mt Classic Production Sale, and the Teets/Griswold Pounds to Profit Bull Sale. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Customers include local consumers seeking farm-raised beef and participants in the farm's production sales, which serve cattle producers and buyers in the livestock industry. The operation sits within the agriculture and food production sectors, with a focus on beef cattle.

The Teets family frames the business around traditional values, a love of the land, and hard work, emphasizing sustainability and family tradition as guiding principles. They state they work together to provide food for the nation.

name: Tegra Medical LLC
old_description: Our people are at the heart of what we do. They are driving force behind our success as a contract manufacturer of medical devices. Their expertise, dedication, and passion ensure that we consistently deliver high-quality products and services to our customers.
about:
Tegra Medical LLC operates as a contract manufacturer of medical devices from its headquarters in Franklin, Massachusetts. The company maintains a global footprint with production facilities in the United States, Costa Rica, Switzerland, Malaysia, China, and Singapore, including sites in Hernando, Dartmouth, Altstätten, Hallau, Heerbrugg, Johor Bahru, and Nantong City. This distributed network supports a local-for-local strategy aimed at reducing supply-chain risk and shipping costs for OEM customers.

The firm provides end-to-end manufacturing services spanning design and prototyping through its GENESIS Tech Center® to full-scale production, assembly, packaging, and sterilization. Core processes include injection molding, precision wire and tubing fabrication with secondary operations such as grinding, cutting, coating, end treatments, and custom mandrel production. A Quick Wire & Tubing store stocks stainless steel, nitinol, and coated wire plus tubing for rapid prototyping needs.

Tegra serves medical device OEMs across specialties including oncology, ophthalmics, women's health, advanced orthopedics, minimally invasive surgery, drug delivery, cardiovascular and neurology, cardiac rhythm management, and robotic-assisted surgery. The company emphasizes collaboration with OEM partners to deliver precision-engineered instruments, implants, and finished devices.

Differentiators cited by the company include its integrated end-to-end model, the GENESIS Tech Center for accelerated development, a quality system built on ISO 13485 certification and FDA QSR compliance with black-belt engineers and real-time SPC, and sustainability investments such as solar installations and Industry 4.0 digitalization.
